d: Company: Mamlkah Home – International Kingdom for Building Materials LLC
Mamlkah Home is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Procurement Officer to join our purchasing team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and coordinating orders from local and international suppliers, including manufacturers in China and other countries, supporting our diverse building materials, lighting, and home improvement product ranges.

We are looking for someone with strong negotiation, communication, and follow-up skills who can manage the procurement process efficiently, from supplier sourcing and price comparison to order delivery and stock replenishment.
Source, identify, and evaluate local and international suppliers and manufacturers.
Request quotations, analyze offers, and prepare commercial and technical comparisons.
Issue and manage Purchase Orders (POs) through Odoo ERP.
Follow up with suppliers on order confirmations, production progress, readiness, and dispatch schedules.
Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and commercial conditions to achieve the best value.
Coordinate international import operations, including shipping documentation such as Proforma Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, and Bills of Lading.
Coordinate with freight forwarders and customs clearance agents to ensure smooth and timely shipments.
Track shipments and follow up on delivery schedules.
Coordinate with warehouse teams to verify received goods against purchase orders and report any shortages, damages, or discrepancies.
Monitor inventory levels and support purchasing and replenishment planning.
Maintain organized supplier records, purchasing documents, and procurement reports.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with local and international suppliers.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.
1–3 years of practical experience in procurement or purchasing, preferably in a trading or building materials company.
Good understanding of international sourcing, import documentation, and shipping procedures.
Experience with Odoo ERP or other ERP systems is preferred.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and ability to prepare purchasing and commercial comparison reports.
Good negotiation, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
Good command of written and spoken English is required.
Knowledge of Chinese is an advantage.
Ability to manage multiple suppliers and purchasing orders simultaneously.
Opportunity to work with a growing company operating across multiple branches in Oman.
Exposure to international manufacturers, suppliers, and global sourcing activities.
A professional working environment with opportunities for career growth and development.
